updates.details: ACTION REQUIRED ALL USERS OF /work/scratch-pw5: As per announcement, this volume needs to reduce usage to below 500TB so that it can be re-sized.

Tape services are currently suspended.  This affects Elastic Tape, JDMA and NLA.  Ingests will continue to write to the buffer, and will be processed when the tape is back online.  Recalls are suspended.
All tape services are available again.
CEDA and JASMIN Services will be unsupported on Monday 31st August due to the bank holiday. Responses to queries may take longer than usual this week.
